payload.summary: pr-policy treats the differential data as clinical-risk but not the code that interprets it
payload.detail: scripts/pr-policy.mjs classifyPullRequestFiles marks data/differentials-snapshot.json as a clinical-risk surface, but src/lib/differential-records.ts is not matched by clinicalRiskPatterns. That file decides whether a stored 'outdated' record is presented as current or outdated, so the governed data is protected and the code deriving its clinical status is not. Found while fixing the rowGovernance re-verification defect (PR for claude/differential-governance). Not fixed in that PR deliberately: widening clinicalRiskPatterns changes which future PRs are held for governance preflight, which is a governance-surface decision for the owner, not a side effect of a behaviour fix. Options are (a) add the three record-governance modules to clinicalRiskPatterns, (b) add only differential-records.ts, or (c) accept the asymmetry and record why.
